title: Family, starting on drums, then piano bought by his mother
summary: No one else in his family played music. He taught himself drums, and his parents bought him drums and a piano; he stuck with piano because it got him more work.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did your parents play any instrument, any musical family?

No, only one in the family. The only one? Only one that played music. Did you have any brothers or sisters that played? No brothers or sisters. I just didn't get up myself. Who was your first teacher? Well my first teacher was a lady by the name of Camilla Todd.
And by the way, did you start on piano or any other instrument?
No, I started on, I played drum at one time. First? Before you took up piano? Yeah, I took up piano. And then uh…

Yeah, I played drum before I picked up piano. Then I started to fool, my mother bought me a piano, that's been many years ago. And I started to fool around with the piano and uh… That's before I ever take any kind of lessons. I mostly learnt myself, you know what I mean, by air, voice. Yeah. And then uh… After I started to improve on the piano, I got hired more on piano than I did drums. So I decided to stick to the piano.
When you started on drums, did you just pick that up yourself?
Picked that up myself. Mm-hmm. I picked that up myself.
Did your folks get you the drum set or did you have to earn it yourself or how did you get it?
No, no, they bought me something. They bought me the piano and also the drums. Yes.
So they encouraged you then to take up music?
Well, I mean, I liked it myself, you see. And I used to beat on the steps, you know, with drum sticks, you know, with my steps. So they noticed that, so they bought me a set of drums and then…
Did you take any lessons at all on drums?
Not at drums, no. I take lessons at piano.
